A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same InsViE-1M dataset and video-editing model. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary sections are readable and support comparison, including content moved into the appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original model comparisons and filtering, training-stage, and static-real ratio ablations in Tables 4–5, plus the CFG selection analysis in Figure 11.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds TGVE/TGVE+ comparisons, InsV2V retraining results, and an isolated LPIPS-loss ablation in Tables 6 and 9.

M1.justification: The dataset-construction pipeline, CogVideoX-2B model with LoRA, three-stage training, LPIPS loss, and dual-condition sampling remain unchanged. LPIPS was already part of v1; its new ablation does not introduce a method component.

E1.justification: v2 adds actual evaluations on TGVE and TGVE+ in Table 6 alongside the retained 100-video test drawn from DAVIS, YoutubeVOS, and Pexels. This extends benchmark coverage within the existing video-editing task; training-data sources and InsViE-1M composition remain unchanged.

E2.justification: New Table 6 evaluates EVE and an InsV2V variant retrained on InsViE-1M, denoted InsV2V*. The original Table 4 comparator set and qualitative comparison methods are retained. Senorita-2M is discussed but not experimentally compared.

E3.justification: The added TGVE/TGVE+ evaluation specifies resizing to 720×480 and back to 480×480, and introduces ViCLIPdir and ViCLIPout alongside PickScore and temporal CLIP. New controls examine InsV2V retraining and removing LPIPS. Previously reported training settings and the original test protocol remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds two focused analyses: retraining InsV2V to assess the dataset's contribution independently of the proposed architecture, and removing LPIPS from Stage 3 to assess its contribution. The existing filtering, training-stage, CFG, and static-real ratio analyses are retained; the ratio results move to appendix Table 8.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the model comparisons. The additional results continue the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: New benchmark and control results substantially extend the empirical evidence. Table 6 reports InsViE PickScores of 20.90/20.97 on TGVE/TGVE+, although its TGVE temporal CLIP of 0.941 trails TokenFlow's 0.943. Table 9 adds the without-LPIPS result, including DOVER 0.543 versus the retained 0.567 with LPIPS. Earlier comparison and ablation values remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The diffusion objective and dual-condition guidance equations, Equations 1–2, retain the same mathematical content. No new formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or derivations are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the same central claims about the million-triplet dataset, two-stage editing/filtering pipeline, and progressively trained video-editing model. The new experiments support these existing claims without redefining them.

C2.justification: v2 newly states that irrelevant instruction content slightly worsens performance and attributes this to predominantly clean training instructions. It also interprets InsV2V retraining gains as evidence of dataset value and the isolated LPIPS results as primarily benefiting video quality. Earlier limitations remain.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 newly discloses inference and training resource estimates: 90s/20G/1GPU and 100h/75G/64GPUs. These are additional disclosures, not documented changes to the training budget. Existing optimizer settings, loss weights, hardware configuration, and code-access link are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to EVE, the TGVE competition, and Senorita-2M. Section 2 contrasts Senorita-2M's classifier/CLIP filtering with InsViE's GPT-4o filtering and suggests their potential combination. This is a limited expansion of the existing research positioning.

P1.justification: Changes comprise localized explanations, author affiliation/contact edits, corrected figure references, and a new supplementary Section 10 containing additional and relocated ablation discussion. The overall narrative remains intact. Section 5.4 introduces incorrect references to Table 8 for filtering and training-stage results actually shown in Table 5.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 6 and 9, splits the original Table 5 between main-text Table 5 and appendix Table 8, and relocates Table 4 and Figure 11. Existing figures and qualitative examples are retained. Table 6 incorrectly bolds InsViE's TGVE temporal CLIP of 0.941 despite TokenFlow's higher 0.943.

improvement.justification: The TGVE/TGVE+ evaluations, InsV2V retraining comparison, and isolated LPIPS ablation strengthen empirical support beyond v1. Resource estimates and the added instruction-related limitation improve transparency. These useful but bounded gains outweigh the minor new cross-reference and table-highlighting errors, while the core method and earlier results remain unchanged.
